parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description:
The real-time log type. Valid values:

- **dcdn_log_access_l1 (default)**: access logs.
- **dcdn_log_er**: Edge Routine function logs.
- **dcdn_log_waf**: security protection logs.
- **dcdn_log_ipa**: Layer 4 acceleration logs.

parameters.name: Details
parameters.description: The list of ER PODs to configure.

parameters.name: DiscardRate
parameters.description: The discard rate. If not specified, the default value is 0.

parameters.name: FieldName
parameters.description: The selected fields, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: FilterVer
parameters.description:
The version of the filter rule.

> Compatible with legacy filter rules. The default value is v1. Newly created tasks use v2.
